contexts.text: (After resuscitation) paths were seen leading gently upwards, signifying that through the Knowledges of truth and good, and through the acknowledgement of self, he should be gradually led towards Heaven.
A highway for the remnant of the people... () = disposition into order.
Way, and path () = truth. AC 3923:2.
The word ladder, in the Original Language, is derived from a word which means path, or Way, which is predicated of truth.
The highways are laid waste () = truth no longer anywhere.
The restorer of paths to dwell in () = the truths which are of good; for paths, or ways, = truths; and to dwell is predicated of good.
An arrow-snake upon the path () = ratiocination from truth concerning good... A path = truth.
Ways, and paths () = truths.
Under Way, see this reference.
[Swedenborg's footnote]. A way, road, track, lane, or street means things that are true and that lead to something good, as well as false things that lead to something evil.
To sweep a path is to prepare to accept what is true. [In Swedenborg's footnote]. AC 3142.
To make a path known, when it is said of the Lord, is to teach people about the truths that lead to what is good. AC 10564.
Set thine heart toward the highway, the way thou goest () = the affection of the truth which leads to life.
She shall not find thy paths () = that nothing of truth can be seen. Explained.

The highways are laid waste, he who passeth along the way hath ceased () = that there are no longer the goods and truths which lead to Heaven. (The highways laid waste = that there are no longer the goods of life; and he who passeth along the way hath ceased = nor the truths of faith. AE 365:22.)

To be set for a way = to be in truths; and the highways to be exalted () = to be in genuine truths; for ways, and highways, = truths, which are said to be exalted from good; and the truths which are from good are genuine truths.
Way, and path () = the truth and good of the Church.
To destroy the way of the paths () = that the truth which leads is not known.

Desolation is described by, the ways have ceased; those going in paths have gone in crooked ways (). By ways, and paths, are signified... the truths of doctrine which lead; and to go in crooked ways = aberration from truths.
That they will be taught in truths, by which they will be led, is signified by, He will teach us of His ways; and we will go in His paths (): ways = truths; and paths, the precepts of life.

That falsities from Own intelligence avert and reject the influx of truth, is signified by, He hath fenced up My ways with hewn stone; he hath overturned My paths (). By the ways, and paths, of God, are signified the truths which lead to good...
